files.notes: Encrypted as shipped: not the plain 1999 PAK format, so PAKLib cannot read it as stored. Scheme, as worked out by this project: from offset 20 on, bytes are XORed with the repeating key 4c b2 3e 1a, the key restarting at each sprite's own start offset; on top of that, within each sprite the 100-byte header, the frame table and the bitmap are each running-XORed (byte[i] ^= byte[i-4], restarting per region), except the frame count and the colour-key field; after decoding, BMP header bytes 12-17 are garbled and some paks have lost the 'BM' signature. The sprite count and offset table at offset 20 decode with the key alone (checked for all 405 Korean paks). Kept byte for byte as found; no art/ entries for this version.
